name: Prahova Valley
summary: The Prahova Valley is one of the most renowned tourist regions in the Carpathian Mountains of Romania, located along the route of the Prahova River. The Prahova Valley is situated in the south-east of Romania, in the north of Muntenia, in the upper and middle basin of the river of the same name, a tributary of the Ialomița. It borders the Ploiești piedmont plain to the south, the Dâmbovița county over the Bucegi massif to the west, the Brașov depression and the city of Brașov to the north, and the Doftana Valley over the Baiului and Piatra Mare mountains to the east. In the southern sector, the Prahova Valley forms the limit between the Getic Subcarpathians and the Curvature Subcarpathians.
